title: Measuring Harness-Induced Belief Divergence in Multi-Step LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2607.04528v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Software agents are becoming increasingly important in modern coding workflows, where they solve complex tasks through multi-step interaction with code repositories. A central component of these systems is the execution harness, which governs how the underlying LLM observes, acts on, and verifies its environment. We show that the harness can in turn shape the agent's evolving beliefs about the environment, even when the task, environment, and base LLM remain fixed. To reveal this effect, we introduce a belief-rollout diagnostic that traces how an agent's anticipated world state and future decisions evolve under alternative harnesses. We further separate immediate divergence introduced by the interface from divergence that develops over longer horizons. translated_title: 测量多步LLM智能体中由执行框架引起的信念分歧
translated_abstract: 软件智能体在现代编程工作流程中正变得越来越重要，它们通过与代码仓库的多步交互来解决复杂任务。这些系统的核心组件是执行框架，它决定了底层LLM如何观察环境、对环境执行操作以及验证其行为。我们证明了执行框架反过来会塑造智能体对环境不断演变的信念，即使任务、环境和基础LLM保持不变。为了揭示这一效应，我们引入了一种信念推演诊断方法，用于追踪智能体的预期世界状态和未来决策在不同执行框架下如何演变。我们进一步将接口引入的即时分歧与在更长时间范围内发展出的分歧区分开来。在包括HIBench-Code、SWE-bench Verified和Terminal-Bench在内的受控编程任务上，我们发现不同执行框架之间存在显著的信念分歧，而这种分歧从终端输出往往难以察觉。
tldr: 该论文提出信念推演诊断方法，首次揭示执行框架会在任务、环境和基础LLM完全固定的情况下显著塑造多步LLM智能体对环境的信念，导致不同框架间出现从终端输出难以察觉的显著信念分歧。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a belief-rollout diagnostic showing that execution harnesses substantially shape multi-step LLM agents' evolving beliefs about their environments—even when tasks, environments, and base LLMs are fixed—producing cross-harness belief divergence that is often invisible from terminal output.
